method: Each item checked against the primary source where it could be fetched on the as_of date. 'verification' says whether the facts below were confirmed from the primary document or only from a secondary report. Re-verify anything older than six months before presenting it as current.

items.title: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA), FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA)
items.binding: indirect (mandatory for US federal systems; de facto reference for banks and vendors)
items.requirement: Algorithms to adopt: ML-KEM for key establishment; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA for signatures.
items.deadlines: None in the standards themselves; transition dates set by IR 8547 (draft) and US federal policy.

items.title: NIST IR 8547 (Initial Public Draft): Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
items.status: DRAFT (initial public draft; comments closed 2025-01-10; no final version as of as_of date)
items.binding: none (draft guidance); referenced by OMB M-26-15 for federal plans
items.requirement: Proposes deprecating quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms (RSA, ECDSA, ECDH, FF-DH) at 112-bit strength after 2030 and disallowing all after 2035.
items.deadlines: Proposed: deprecated after 2030; disallowed after 2035. Draft dates may change.
items.verification: primary (status); dates per NIST presentation slides and secondary summaries

items.title: FIPS 206: FN-DSA (Falcon)
items.status: in development; public draft release NOT confirmed from a primary source as of as_of date
items.requirement: Compact lattice signatures (smaller than ML-DSA); relevant where signature size matters (certificates, constrained devices).
items.deadlines: Secondary sources estimate final late 2026 or early 2027 (Judgement of those sources).

items.title: HQC selected as backup KEM
items.status: selected; draft standard expected ~2026; final expected 2027 (NIST's stated plan)
items.requirement: Code-based KEM as a backup to ML-KEM; NIST still recommends ML-KEM as primary.
items.deadlines: NIST plan: draft about a year after selection; final 2027.

items.title: CNSA 2.0 (algorithms advisory 2022; FAQ v2.1 Dec 2024)
items.binding: indirect for banks (binds US national security systems; reaches banks through vendors and products)
items.requirement: ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87, LMS/XMSS, AES-256, SHA-384/512 for NSS.
items.deadlines: New NSS acquisitions CNSA 2.0-compliant from 2027-01-01; category 'exclusive use' dates 2030-2033 (e.g. software/firmware signing 2030, web/cloud 2033).
items.verification: secondary for timeline (FAQ PDF fetch failed on as_of date); primary for algorithm list

items.title: NSM-10 (2022-05-04); OMB M-23-02 (2022-11-18); Quantum Computing Cybersecurity Preparedness Act (P.L. 117-260, 2022-12-21)
items.requirement: Annual cryptographic inventories by federal agencies; goal to mitigate quantum risk as much as feasible by 2035.
items.deadlines: 2035 goal (NSM-10); annual inventories (M-23-02).

items.title: Executive Order 14306 (amending EO 14144) — PQC provisions
items.requirement: CISA list of PQC product categories (by 2025-12-01); agencies to support TLS 1.3 or successor.
items.deadlines: TLS 1.3 or successor no later than 2030-01-02.

items.title: Product Categories for Technologies That Use Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
items.requirement: Lists product categories where PQC-capable products are widely available or transitioning.
items.deadlines: None.

items.title: Executive Order 14412: Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks
items.binding: indirect for banks (federal HVAs/high-impact systems; proposed FAR rule for contractors; SRMAs to assist critical infrastructure)
items.requirement: PQC key establishment and signatures on federal high value assets and high impact systems; CBOM minimum-elements guidance from CISA/NIST within 270 days; FAR Council proposed rule within 180 days.
items.deadlines: Key establishment by 2030-12-31; signatures by 2031-12-31 (federal HVA/high-impact). Proposed contractor FIPS compliance by 2030-12-31.

items.title: OMB M-26-15: Execution of the Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography
items.requirement: Agency PQC migration plans incl. inventory methods and automated tools; CBOM recommended in Appendix A ('should'). Five phases 2026-2035.
items.deadlines: Plans due 120 days after memo (2026-10-22, computed); phases: 2026-27 discovery, 2027-28 pilots, 2028-30 prioritised migration, 2031 signatures, 2035 full.
items.verification: primary (memo text summarised; whether it supersedes M-23-02 not stated in memo)

items.title: Banking supervisors: no explicit PQC rule identified
items.status: no binding PQC requirement found for banks
items.binding: none (enters through existing IT, cyber and third-party risk supervision)
items.requirement: No explicit PQC deadline for banks identified. Quantum risk is flagged as emerging risk in supervisory publications; expectations flow through IT/cyber exams and third-party risk management.
items.deadlines: NO BINDING BANK DEADLINE EXISTS (as of as_of date).
items.verification: secondary analysis + OCC report link; re-check FFIEC IT Handbook and any 2026 interagency statements

items.title: PCI DSS v4.0/4.0.1 Requirement 12.3.3
items.requirement: Document and review cryptographic cipher suites and protocols in use at least every 12 months, including an up-to-date inventory, monitoring of industry trends on continued viability, and a documented strategy to respond to anticipated changes in cryptographic vulnerabilities. A de facto crypto-inventory requirement.
items.deadlines: Mandatory from 2025-03-31; review at least every 12 months.
items.verification: secondary (wording per QSA summaries; check the official v4.0.1 text)

items.title: Statement on Planning for the Opportunities and Risks of Quantum Computing
items.requirement: Build knowledge, assess quantum risks, draft a mitigation plan; start planning now; stay crypto-agile.
items.deadlines: None.

items.title: Advancing a Coordinated Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography in the Financial Sector
items.status: roadmap statement (non-binding; 'does not set guidance or regulatory expectations')
items.requirement: Six phases: awareness & preparation; discovery & inventory (incl. third-party dependencies); risk assessment & planning; migration execution; testing; validation & monitoring.
items.deadlines: Indicative: critical systems ~2030-2032; overall ~2035 (non-authoritative).

items.body: EU Member States (NIS Cooperation Group work stream), with the Commission
items.title: A Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography
items.binding: indirect (through national plans; DORA is the binding hook for banks)
items.requirement: National PQC roadmaps and start of planning for high/medium-risk use cases; finance named among high-risk domains.
items.deadlines: By 2026-12-31: national roadmaps and first steps; by 2030-12-31: high-risk use cases migrated; by 2035-12-31: all risk levels.
items.verification: primary page + ENISA slides for milestones

items.title: DORA RTS on ICT risk management framework — Article 6 (encryption and cryptographic controls), Article 7 (key management)
items.requirement: Cryptographic policy must provide for updating or changing cryptographic technology on the basis of developments in cryptanalysis; where not possible, mitigation and monitoring measures, recorded with reasons; key lifecycle management (Art. 7). Recital 9 references quantum advancements.
items.deadlines: No PQC-specific date; obligation is continuous.

items.title: Timelines for migration to post-quantum cryptography
items.binding: none (guidance; regulators may build on it)
items.requirement: Discovery, assessment and initial migration plan; then priority migration; then complete migration.
items.deadlines: By 2028: goals, discovery, plan; by 2031: highest-priority migration; by 2035: complete.

items.title: Advisory on Addressing the Cybersecurity Risks Associated with Quantum (MAS/TCRS/2024/01)
items.binding: supervisory expectation (advisory, supplementary to TRM guidelines and notices)
items.requirement: Maintain cryptographic inventory; identify vulnerable crypto and dependent assets; migration strategy prioritising critical assets; assess crypto-agility; contingency planning.
items.deadlines: None specified.
items.verification: secondary (law-firm summary of the MAS circular); locate MAS circular for primary text

items.title: Quantum Preparedness Index (QPI) and whitepaper
items.date: 2026-07-27 (first reading); announced 2026-02-03 in Fintech Promotion Blueprint
items.binding: supervisory expectation (no compliance deadline for individual banks stated)
items.requirement: Sector-level score across Awareness, Planning, Pilots and Practical Preparedness, based on an early-2026 bank survey; initial score 2.3/10.
items.deadlines: HKMA target: sector QPI of 10 by 2030.

items.title: Expert Committee for a Quantum Secure and Adaptive Financial Ecosystem (Q-SAFE)
items.binding: none yet (no directions or deadlines issued as of as_of date)
items.requirement: ToR: assess benefits/risks; evaluate the sector's cryptographic inventory via a CBOM; assess crypto agility; identify most vulnerable critical systems; cross-country regulatory analysis; industry readiness; recommend a roadmap.
items.deadlines: Report within six months of the committee's first meeting (date not public in press release).

items.title: Implementation of Quantum Safe Ecosystem in India — Report of the Task Force
items.binding: indirect (government roadmap; sector regulators such as RBI may adopt)
items.requirement: Phased PQC adoption; CII sectors start formal implementation; vendors to provide CBOMs; financial services named as a priority sector (per reporting).
items.deadlines: CII formal PQC implementation from 2027; full nationwide adoption targeted by 2033 (per reporting).

items.title: Project Leap phase 2: quantum-proofing payment systems
items.requirement: Replaced traditional signatures with PQC for liquidity transfers in an operational payment system; found significant performance differences and many components needing changes.
items.deadlines: None.

items.title: Quantum-readiness for the financial system: a roadmap (BIS Papers No 158)
items.requirement: Start now; governance; automated + manual crypto inventory; prioritise by data sensitivity/shelf life; crypto-agility and hybrid schemes; pilots; supervisors to integrate quantum risk into cyber frameworks.
items.deadlines: None (notes NIST's 2030/2035 RSA timeline).

items.title: Call for action: urgent plan needed to transition to post-quantum cryptography together
items.requirement: Prioritise transition to quantum-safe cryptography; coordinated effort across financial institutions and policymakers.
items.deadlines: None.

items.title: PQC Working Group Future State Technical Paper
items.requirement: Inventory metadata and discovery methods; Mosca-based prioritisation; crypto-agility; vendor management with PQC questions in TPRM.
items.deadlines: None; expects 5-20 year transition.

items.title: Post Quantum Cryptography Financial Readiness Needs Assessment
items.requirement: Company-wide programme; inventory; risk-based prioritisation; migration plan; vendor engagement; crypto-agility.
items.deadlines: None.

items.title: SWIFT PQC plans
items.status: NOT VERIFIED from a SWIFT primary source
items.binding: would be contractual for SWIFT users once published
items.requirement: Third-party reporting expects PQC-enabled SwiftNet around 2027 with a migration window; treat as unconfirmed.
items.deadlines: Unconfirmed. Obtain SWIFT customer documentation before using.
items.verification: secondary only — do not present as SWIFT's commitment
